title: 第十一章 众人设局灌酒第十二章 报名受阻
slug: 震惊五星灵帝被逼着撩妹
lines: 杨卤打伤圣女的消息，在宗门里炸开了锅。
虽然瑶青池没有声张，但当时冰澜阁附近有几个路过的弟子，远远看见了杨卤扇圣女巴掌的那一幕。消息像长了翅膀一样传遍整个星澜宗，不到半天功夫，所有弟子都知道了——
那个新来的神谕灵天才，扇了圣女一巴掌。
而且还天天给圣女送早餐，送完就打人，打完继续送。
这操作，简直离谱他妈给离谱开门，离谱到家了。
“这人是真的疯了吧？打圣女？他怎么敢的？”
“最离谱的是圣女居然没找他算账？就让他这么走了？”
“我听说是圣女先动的手，他正当防卫。”
“废话，圣女动手那叫教训，他动手那叫以下犯上！懂不懂什么叫规矩？”
“但人家确实是神谕灵天赋啊，宗主都不舍得罚，谁敢动他？”
议论归议论，但所有人心里都有一个共同的念头——这人太嚣张了，必须给他点颜色看看。
于是，当天晚上，几个内门弟子凑在了一起，商量对策。
“那小子有个能增幅力量的戒指，咱们得想办法给他弄下来。”一个身材微胖的弟子说道，他叫刘万，是内门里最爱搞事的一个。
“弄下来？怎么弄？直接抢？”另一个弟子叫李成，挠了挠头，“那小子连三星灵尊长老都不怕，咱们去抢不是送菜吗？”
“硬来不行，那就智取。”刘万嘿嘿一笑，压低声音说道，“咱们请他喝酒，把他灌醉，趁他醉得不省人事的时候，把戒指撸下来！”
李成眼睛一亮：“好主意！他再能打，没了戒指总还能打吧？”
“就这么定了！”
一群人合计完毕，第二天一大早就开始准备。他们买了十几坛灵酒，又准备了几碟下酒菜，然后派李成去请杨卤。
杨卤正在自己的小厢房里打坐，听到敲门声，打开门就看到李成一脸热情地站在门口。
“杨师弟！今晚咱们内门弟子搞了个小聚会，大家一起喝喝酒聊聊天，你也来吧！”李成笑眯眯地说道。
杨卤看了他一眼，眉头微微一挑。
无事献殷勤，非奸即盗。
他活了四百七十六年，什么样的人没见过？李成脸上那点小心思，他一眼就看穿了。
但杨卤没有拒绝。
“好啊，几点？在哪儿？”
“傍晚，东院凉亭！不见不散！”李成见他答应，喜出望外，生怕他反悔，转身就跑了。
杨卤看着他的背影，嘴角微微上扬。
想灌醉他？
他五星灵帝大圆满的肉身，别说几坛灵酒了，就算是百坛千坛，也休想让他醉倒。
他倒要看看，这群人到底想玩什么花样。
傍晚时分，杨卤准时来到东院凉亭。
凉亭里摆了一张圆桌，桌上放着十几坛灵酒，还有几盘花生米、酱牛肉之类的下酒菜。刘万、李成等七八个内门弟子已经坐好了，见杨卤来了，纷纷热情打招呼。
content_en:
The news that Yang Lu injured the saint exploded in the sect.
Although Yao Qingchi did not say anything, several disciples passing by near Binglan Pavilion saw Yang Lu slapping the saint from a distance. The news spread throughout the Xinglan Sect like it had wings. In less than half a day, all the disciples knew about it——
The new oracle spirit genius slapped the saint.
Moreover, he would deliver breakfast to the Holy Lady every day. After delivering it, he would beat the person, and then continue to deliver it after the beating.
This operation is simply outrageous. Opening the door is outrageous. It's outrageous.
"Is this person really crazy? Beating the saint? How dare he?"
"The most outrageous thing is that the saint didn't settle the score with him? Just let him leave like this?"
"I heard that the saint struck first, and he was acting in self-defense."
"Nonsense, if the saint does something, it's called a lesson, if he does something, it's called a crime! Do you understand what the rules are?"
"But he is indeed gifted with the Oracle Spirit. The sect leader is not willing to punish him. Who dares to touch him?"
Discussions are discussions, but everyone has a common thought in their hearts - this person is too arrogant, and he must be given some color.
So, that night, several inner disciples got together to discuss countermeasures.
"That kid has a ring that can increase his strength. We have to find a way to get it for him." A slightly fat disciple said, his name is Liu Wan, and he is the most trouble-making one in the inner sect.
"Get it? How to get it? Just grab it?" Another disciple named Li Cheng scratched his head, "That kid is not even afraid of Elder Sanxing Spiritual Lord. If we go to grab it, aren't we giving him food?"
"If you can't do it by force, then use outsmarting." Liu Wan chuckled and lowered his voice and said, "Let's treat him to a drink, get him drunk, and take off the ring while he's drunk and unconscious!"
Li Cheng's eyes lit up: "What a great idea! No matter how good he is at fighting, he can still fight without the ring, right?"
"That's it!"
A group of people completed the calculation and started preparations early the next morning. They bought more than a dozen jars of spiritual wine, prepared several dishes to go with the wine, and then sent Li Cheng to invite Yang Lu.
Yang Lu was meditating in his small room when he heard a knock on the door. When he opened the door, he saw Li Cheng standing at the door with an enthusiastic face.
"Junior Brother Yang! Our inner disciples are having a small gathering tonight. Let's all drink and chat together. You can come too!" Li Cheng said with a smile.
Yang Lu glanced at him and raised his eyebrows slightly.
Showing courtesy for nothing is either cheating or stealing.
He has lived for four hundred and seventy-six years. What kind of person has he not seen? He could see through the little thoughts on Li Cheng's face at a glance.
But Yang Lu did not refuse.
"Okay, what time is it? Where is it?"
"In the evening, at the pavilion in the east courtyard! See you there or not!" Li Cheng was overjoyed when he saw that he had agreed. He was afraid that he would regret it, so he turned around and ran away.
Yang Lu looked at his back and raised the corners of his mouth slightly.
Want to get him drunk?
His five-star spiritual emperor's perfect body, let alone several jars of spiritual wine, even hundreds of jars of spiritual wine, could not get him drunk.
He wanted to see what tricks these people wanted to play.
In the evening, Yang Lu arrived at the pavilion in the east courtyard on time.
A round table was set up in the pavilion, with more than a dozen jars of spiritual wine on the table, as well as several plates of peanuts, soy sauce beef and other snacks. Liu Wan, Li Cheng and other seven or eight inner disciples were already seated. When they saw Yang Lu coming, they all greeted him warmly.
title_en: Chapter 11 Everyone sets up a trap to get drunk Chapter 12 Registration is blocked
